skill_name: Analyze this article and give me a short summary.
workflow: Adequate sleep is essential for our physical and mental wellbeing. Studies have shown that sleeping too little or sleeping at odd hours can lead to negative outcomes such as decreased cognitive performance, increased risk of injury, and weakened immunity. In addition, there is evidence to suggest that lack of sleep can contribute to an increased likelihood of depression and anxiety. To stay healthy, it is important to make sure that we get enough sleep.
